gloss: No obstacles from wind and rain; perseverance through difficulties.
teaser: Ever wonder how to describe someone who never lets challenges stop them?
script: Welcome to Chengyu Bites — your quick summary on Chinese 成语. Ever wonder how to describe someone who never lets challenges stop them? [break 1s] The phrase is: 风雨无阻, fēng yǔ wú zǔ. [break 1s] 风 (fēng) - wind [break 0.5s] 雨 (yǔ) - rain [break 0.5s] 无 (wú) - no [break 0.5s] 阻 (zǔ) - obstruction [break 0.5s] The full idiom again is 风雨无阻, which literally means 'no obstacles from wind and rain', and figuratively signifies perseverance through difficulties. [break 1s] Here’s the story behind it: [break 1.5s] This idiom originates from the idea that regardless of weather conditions, a person should continue on their path without giving in to challenges. It emphasizes determination and resilience, often used to encourage others to keep moving forward despite obstacles. [break 1.5s] Example one: 只要有梦想，风雨无阻，奋斗就是成功。 [break 1s] As long as there are dreams, no obstacles from wind and rain, striving is success. [break 1s] Example two: 他每天都去跑步，风雨无阻。 [break 1s] He runs every day, no matter the wind and rain. [break 1s] Example three: 我们的团队风雨无阻地完成了项目。 [break 1s] Our team completed the project without any obstacles from wind and rain. [break 1s] So, the idiom is 风雨无阻, meaning perseverance through difficulties. Thank you for listening to Chengyu Bites! See you next time for another idiom. [break 1s]
